svg.aria-label: DNS resolution: the host asks its local resolver; on a cache miss the resolver asks a root server, which refers it to the .com TLD server, which refers it to the authoritative server for example.com, which returns the IP address; the resolver caches the answer for its TTL.
svg.title: DNS resolution: the host asks its local resolver; on a cache miss the resolver asks a root server, which refers it to the .com TLD server, which refers it to the authoritative server for example.com, which returns the IP address; the resolver caches the answer for its TTL.
svg.text: 1 laptop asks its resolver · 2–4 resolver walks the hierarchy (each answer is cached) · 5 IP returned to the laptop
